newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO to raise some steel product prices.
newsitem.headline: POSCO to raise some steel product prices.

text.p: South Korea's largest steelmaker, Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO), said on Wednesday it would raise hot-rolled coil sales prices for local exporters by 6.4 percent effective from July 6.
A POSCO statement said the prices would rise to 285,000 won per tonne against 267,800 at present.
POSCO will also raise iron rod sales prices for local exporters by 3.1 percent to 304,000 won per tonne against a current 295,000 won.
But prices for domestic consumers will remain unchanged.
The price adjustments were in line with rising steel prices on the world market, the statement said. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
